verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's first-party docs state that all /api endpoints authenticate with private API keys that carry API key scopes. Scopes are positioned as a way to limit what third parties can access, and a 'Custom' access option lets you decide exactly how much access to grant. OAuth with scopes is also offered for app integrations, so a user can issue least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: detail on scope granularity (per-resource read/write lists), explicit guidance tying scoped keys to the MCP server or agent use, key revocation/expiry controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
